facts.detail: Ofcom published the scam-protection guide on 15 July 2026.
The guide was last updated on 22 July 2026.
The guide says not to reply, click links, press buttons or share personal details.
Users are advised to check for urgency, unexpected requests and suspicious links.
Suspicious texts should be forwarded to 7726.
Scam calls can be reported through Report Fraud.
The guide points people in Scotland to Police Scotland on 101.
The guide warns against giving personal, banking, PIN, password or National Insurance details to unexpected callers.
Users should end suspicious contact and reach the organisation through independently verified details.
The guide describes number blocking, caller screening, spam filters and provider network-level filtering.

facts.detail: BDUK published the Project Gigabit Evaluation Plan on 15 August 2025.
Ipsos UK authored the plan as an independent contractor.
BDUK commissioned Ipsos UK and partners to undertake the evaluation.
The plan identifies BDUK as an executive agency within DSIT.
The evaluation includes Gigabit Infrastructure Subsidy and Gigabit Broadband Voucher Scheme interventions.
The plan covers Project Gigabit overall and the GIS and GBVS interventions individually.
Project Gigabit targets hard-to-reach communities.
The programme targets homes and businesses outside suppliers’ expected commercial deployments.
GIS subsidises network delivery described as gigabit capable, with download speeds of at least 1,000 Mbps.
The plan describes vouchers worth up to £4,500 for eligible homes and businesses.
